Schools Celebrate Independence Day with Festivities

Multiple schools across India celebrated the 77th Independence Day with patriotic events and cultural programs. Students and staff participated in festivities, showcasing their national pride. Events included parades, speeches, and performances highlighting India's history and achievements. Schools like Shri Kund Kund Jain Public School, Divya Bhaskar Public School, and Mahavir Vidyalaya marked the occasion with enthusiasm.
